decision_boundary: required macros are ACQUIRE(pen)->FIND_USE(desklamp); extra verbal restatement of the final examine goal is not a separate frozen planner macro and does not create conflict
original_tp_memory_text: Plan: Search the listed containers systematically for a pen, checking drawers and shelves and opening closed drawers as needed. When the pen is found, take it. Continue searching the remaining drawers and shelves for a desklamp; once found, use/turn on the desklamp, then examine the pen with the desklamp.
